referenceComposition: Review complete
sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: MarkerContent contains the actual boundary/status text. MarkerIcon is hidden by the source and cannot be the only meaning.
updatesAndDescendants: Marker defaults to a div through useRender; variants change appearance without creating selection or navigation state. Parent content changes update the text. If a caller supplies a native interactive render, its native contract applies.
referenceDecision: Unread messages is a concrete textual boundary label, not a value protocol inferred from the icon name.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.

marker.description: Native informative div or explicit caller native render override.
